messages:
maya: FYI PDX pop started showing a p99 jump ~09:12 UTC, baseline ~60ms -> ~320-380ms, steady p50 unchanged.
jon: saw throughput drop on a subset of hosts, replication queues growing.
sasha: I pulled flow logs — upstream ISP A rewrote route to ISP B at 09:10, TTLs/dns unchanged but AS path swapped.
liam: that would cause different egress path and changed RTTs, could also flip kernel selector heuristics.
maya: exact symptom: kernel selector oscillating between optimized and generic kernels, batch sizes drop to 1-2, kv cache miss rate spikes.
jon: profiling snapshot attached (small paste):
```
kernel_select: 9ms -> 72ms
batch_heuristic: choose_batch_size median 8 -> 2
kv_cache: hit_rate 87% -> 41%
cpu steal + iowait up ~6%
```
maya: infra-bot confirms no recent runtime deploys to PDX during the window. infra-bot: deploy-bot: no successful runtime deploys to pdx since 2026-02-11T08:30Z.
sasha: traceroute (abridged):
1 10.x.x.x ...
7 203.x.y.z (via ISP A) 18ms
8 198.x.y.z (via ISP B) 110ms
=> big jump at hop 8.
liam: suggestion: pin kernel selector to 'latency-stable' profile for PDX and force batching target=8 for 10m canary.
jon: +1, also bump kv cache prefetch warmup to aggressive for that pop, we saw warmup regain hit rate after ~60s in staging.
maya: hitting the toggles now: /run runtime-pin --pop pdx --kernel latency-stable --batch-target 8  (running canary on 3 hosts)
jon: can we also route egress via ISP A temporarily? network-team suggested we can nudge BGP weight for the cluster.
sasha: opened ticket with ISP B provider (ticket 4321) asking for path restore, provided traceroutes.
liam: profiling after 2m of canary: kernel_select -> 11ms, batch median 7, kv hit 81%, p99 down to ~90ms.
maya: confirmed p99 improving on canary hosts :thumbsup: rolling to remaining hosts now.
jon: note for postmortem: kernel selector should include egress-path signal (AS path/RTT) to avoid flipping heuristics on transient routing changes.
sasha: also add a small hysteresis in kv cache eviction during route perturbation to avoid mass cold-start.
maya: agreed. I'll collect flamegraphs and upload to /incidents/pdx-routing-2367894321.
infra-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0893, assigned eng-runtime.
liam: nice catch. final action items: 1) add egress-aware heuristic ticket, 2) hysteresis for kv eviction, 3) run chaos test to simulate ISP path flip.
maya: copying notes to the weekly postmortem thread, will follow up with timelines and perf graphs. :eyes:
